title: Christians in the Roman Empire at 40 percent growth a decade, AD 40–350 (log scale)
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale of Rodney Stark's projection of the number of Christians, starting from 1,000 in AD 40 and growing 40 percent a decade, worked through by kloom. AD 40, 1,000; 100, 7,530; 150, 40,500; 200, 218,000; 250, 1.17 million; 300, 6.3 million; 350, 33.9 million. A model, not a count: no one counted early Christians.
heading: CHRISTIANS AT 40% A DECADE · LOG SCALE

source.container: Rodney Stark, The Rise of Christianity (Princeton University Press, 1996), Table 1.1, worked through by kloom
